links.outcome: Translation accuracy of ChatGPT-4o for English-Nepali voice translation, by direction
links.effect: Of 485 translations, 282 (58.1%) highest accuracy, 134 (27.6%) moderate, 69 (14.2%) lowest; 63 of 69 low-accuracy translations (91.3%) occurred in Nepali-to-English direction.
links.quote: Of 485 translations, 282 (58.1%) received the highest accuracy rating, 134 (27.6%) a moderate rating, and 69 (14.2%) the lowest.

links.outcome: Translation errors on spontaneous non-English spoken inputs with colloquial, culturally specific speech
links.effect: Nepali-to-English mean accuracy 2.23 ± 0.86 vs English-to-Nepali 2.63 ± 0.53; deviations included distortion of meaning (17.1%), omission (14.2%), and addition (11.5%).
links.quote: Mean accuracy was higher for English-to-Nepali than Nepali-to-English translation (2.63 ± 0.53 vs 2.23 ± 0.86); 63 of 69 low-accuracy translations (91.3%) occurred in the Nepali-to-English direction.

unlisted_practices: Bilingual human verification of AI voice translation when errors could affect research validity or clinical decisions

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o's real-time spoken translation accuracy and error patterns during live field interactions between English-speaking researchers/staff and Nepali community participants near a hospital.
